tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background and the stage background. Light follows the CNC Kitchen apps' paper tone.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Panels, dialogs and cards that sit on surface: the controls sidebar, the header, the gallery tiles.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: A recessed drawing area inside a panel, such as the board drawing in Sides: darker than surface in every theme (D90). Text on it stays ink.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text, labels, legends on surface and surface-raised (13.7:1 or more).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Notes, status-bar hints and units on surface and surface-raised (5.5:1 or more).

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines round groups: fieldsets and the More… and View… menus. Decorative only: 1.3:1, never the sole mark of a control.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, selects, buttons and gallery tiles; 3.5:1 or more on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: divider
tokens.usage: Rules between regions: under the header, above the plan bar and the status bar, beside the sidebar and the step rail.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Error text and invalid-field outline on surface and surface-raised (7:1). From the project's own #b00020. Always paired with the message text.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Skådis Air: a warning that does not block, such as a board larger than the bed or a thickness outside 4 to 5.5 mm. Text on surface (5.6:1 light). Always with words.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: The primary button's fill (the only filled control); the ring and border of every selected state; the chosen radio's dot and a pressed Sides box; links and the focus ring (5.5:1 on surface).

tokens.name: action-tint
tokens.usage: Hover on a control that can be used, and every selected state (D26); text on it stays ink.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Text on action fills (5.7:1 or more).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: The page behind an open modal dialog (its ::backdrop), dimmed so the dialog stands out 3:1: in light by its face, in dark by its border-strong edge, as no dimming of a dark page lifts a dark dialog off it. ink at 50 % in light, black at 50 % in dark.

tokens.name: model-panel
tokens.usage: A panel piece in the 3D stage (project's 0x9aa7b5). Same in both themes: a material, not UI.

tokens.name: model-joint
tokens.usage: Joint strips and cross pieces in the stage (0x5f6b77).

tokens.name: model-outline
tokens.usage: Edge lines over the stage (0x3c4650).

tokens.name: model-tape
tokens.usage: Foam seal tape in the stage (0xd9822b). Orange means seal.

tokens.name: model-tpu
tokens.usage: Printed TPU seal parts in the stage (0x2b2b2b). Lighter on the dark stage, where the near-black seal and its outline both vanished (1.29:1 and 1.90:1).

tokens.name: model-board
tokens.usage: Skådis Air: a pegboard in the stage (0xc9cdd1). A material, not UI. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: model-board-outline
tokens.usage: Skådis Air: edge lines over the board (0x4a525a).

families.ui: "FiraCode Nerd Font", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Page or tool name on a header-less page (landing, about).

styles.name: step
styles.usage: The step's title at the top of the sidebar ("Window"), and the tool's name in a wide header.

styles.name: note
styles.usage: Help text under a field and error messages.

styles.name: label-caps
styles.usage: Section labels in the sidebar, uppercase and tracked (OPENING, SEAL); the status bar takes its size in normal case, so hints read as sentences.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: A type style for code set apart, as .ws-type-code; nothing in bundle.css applies it. An inline <code>, such as -print-8, keeps the text's size, in the one family with ligatures off.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between a label and its input; above a note.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between radio options; inside a tile.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Above each label in a fieldset; toolbar gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding and gaps between fieldsets.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: A dialog's padding, and the gap above its buttons.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page padding on the long-text pages.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Maximum width of running text (the measuring guide, docs). The tool itself is not a column: see workbench.

tokens.name: panel-width
tokens.usage: Width of the controls sidebar (380px), at most half the screen, beside the stage; collapsing it with an edge toggle is planned, not built.

tokens.name: header-h
tokens.usage: Height of the header toolbar (48px). One of the bars side by side: with the plan bar's and the status bar's, it sets H, the least screen height for the sidebar beside the stage (D75).

tokens.name: status-h
tokens.usage: Height of the status bar's row, inside its padding (space-1 above and below) and its top rule: the bar is 41px in all. One of the bars side by side, where it keeps one row, its hint cut short (D75).

tokens.name: tap
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target (44px).

tokens.name: control-h
tokens.usage: Height of buttons, choice buttons, toggles, rail buttons, inputs and selects (a field's block padding is derived from it, D68), the side of a Select's chevron square, and the least height of map cells and disclosure summaries. Becomes tap (44px) on touch screens: its touch value, which tokens.css sets once, for a coarse pointer.

tokens.name: control-pad-y
tokens.usage: Derived, never set: what control-h leaves of one line, above it and below it. A Disclosure summary's block padding, and a field's less its border, so one line of either is control-h tall (D68). control-h is read at the root, its touch value on a touch screen; lh where the padding is, so the line is the element's own.

tokens.name: field-pad-x
tokens.usage: Inline padding inside inputs and selects; their block padding is derived from control-h (D68).

tokens.name: icon-gap
tokens.usage: Space between an icon and its label; a radio or a Sides box, drawn with a ring border, sits icon-gap plus ring from its label.

tokens.name: radio-size
tokens.usage: Diameter of the radio mark inside a Choice button, and the side of the Sides box.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Width of focus outlines, selected outlines, the radio's and the Sides box's border, and the action-tint gap inside a chosen radio. The radio's offsets are derived from it.

tokens.name: dialog-w
tokens.usage: Maximum width of a dialog; on a narrower screen it keeps space-4 from each edge.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Opacity of a disabled control.

tokens.name: stage-fit
tokens.usage: How much of the stage the part fills when it is framed: its outline spans this share of the stage's limiting side (D15).

tokens.name: stage-min-fill
tokens.usage: Zooming out stops when the part's outline spans this share of the stage's shorter side, so it never shrinks to a dot (D15).

tokens.name: plan-line-min
tokens.usage: The least width of the plan bar's sentence on any screen, so about two lines of 14 or more characters: the bar is one row on every screen, the sentence beside the primary button, which shows a short label (D39, D75). Measured, not guessed: with the short label the sentence is 117px at 320px wide, the narrowest checked screen (Chromium), and 185px beside the sidebar at 768px; beside the full label it was 15px. Nothing in the stylesheet reads it; scripts/check-previews.py fails a screen where the sentence is narrower.

tokens.name: number-field-w
tokens.usage: Widest a number field grows: a number and its spinner, not the sidebar's width.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Width of every hairline: control borders, group borders and the rules between regions.

tokens.name: sides-w
tokens.usage: Skådis Air: width of the board drawing in Sides.

tokens.name: sides-h
tokens.usage: Skådis Air: height of the board drawing in Sides.

tokens.name: stage-phone-h
tokens.usage: Below the breakpoint, the 3D view's share of the screen height; the plan bar and status bar sit under it, not inside it (D25). svh, so a phone's sliding toolbar never resizes it.

tokens.name: breakpoint-wide
tokens.usage: Screen width at which the sidebar sits beside the stage, on a screen at least H tall: the least height at which the header, the plan bar and the status bar, one row each, leave the 3D view 40 %, which scripts/build-tokens.py derives from their tokens (D75). A media query cannot read a variable, so the stylesheet repeats it; scripts/build-tokens.py checks the two match.

tokens.name: breakpoint-header
tokens.usage: Screen width from which the header shows its actions in its row; narrower, they sit in More… (D28), and the version with them (D51). Wider than breakpoint-wide, so the tool's name stays whole beside them (D49). Checked like the breakpoints.

tokens.name: breakpoint-short
tokens.usage: Below this screen height nothing is pinned: on a short or zoomed screen the stage scrolls with the page, so it never hides the form (D25), and the 3D view's own controls go into View… (D36). Side by side does not wait for it: a screen goes side by side from H tall (D75). A media query cannot read a variable; scripts/build-tokens.py checks the stylesheet repeats it.

tokens.name: landscape-ratio
tokens.usage: A screen at least this much wider than tall and at least breakpoint-side-min wide puts the sidebar beside the stage from H tall, as breakpoint-wide does (D75), so a landscape phone is not stacked (D25). Narrower, it stacks and pins nothing (D41). Checked like the breakpoints.

tokens.name: breakpoint-side-min
tokens.usage: The least width for the sidebar beside the stage on a landscape screen narrower than breakpoint-wide (D41): such a screen stacks as a phone held upright does and pins nothing, so the view keeps stage-phone-h and the page scrolls. With H, the least height side by side (D75), it makes the least screen side by side. Checked like the breakpoints.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, gallery tiles and notices: softly rounded.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Fieldset groups and dialogs.
